    and "hfinf \<equiv> \<lambda> (f :: real \<Rightarrow> real). (\<forall> x :: real. f x \<ge> 0) \<and> continuous_on {0..} f \<and> (\<forall> x > 0. (interval_lebesgue_integral lebesgue 0 x f) / x = sqrt((f 0) * (f x)))"
  shows "(\<forall> f :: real \<Rightarrow> real. (hfinf f \<longrightarrow> (\<exists> g \<in> ({f :: real \<Rightarrow> real. \<exists> a c :: real. a \<ge> 0 \<and> f = (\<lambda> x. a / (1 - c * x)^2)}). \<forall> x \<ge> 0. g x = f x)) \<and>

  (\<forall> f \<in> ({f :: real \<Rightarrow> real. \<exists> a c :: real. a \<ge> 0 \<and> f = (\<lambda> x. a / (1 - c * x)^2)}). hfinf f \<or> (\<exists> e > 0. hf e f))"
